full_judgment: 2. The opposite party as plaintiff filed a suit being Title Suit No. 246 of 1998 in the court of the Assistant Judge, First Court, Gazipur impleading the petitioners as defendants under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act praying for restoration of possession of the suit properties alleging, inter alia, that the suit land originally belonged to Abdul Mollah (2), Jobdul Mollah and Sabdul Mollah and CS Khatian No. 12 has correctly been recorded in their names and that Jobdul Mollah died leaving behind only daughter Moymannessa and accordingly, SA record and RS record were prepared in the name of the said Moymannessa and that she sold out the suit land by registered sale deed on 31-7-1974 in favour of Abirjan who again sold the same in favour of Alekjan and that Alekjan transferred the said land in favour of the plaintiff who has been possessing the said suit land till he was dispossessed by the defendants forcibly on 15- 10-1998 at 9-00 AM and constructed two tin chapra over the suit land and defendants did not vacate the suit land and hence the plaintiff filed the aforesaid suit.
